BiblicalUsage: ʼEthnîy was a Levite, a son of Zerah. The name occurs once, in 1 Chronicles. The fuller story lives on the People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ʼEthnîy is a reminder that God works through ordinary people whose names we barely know. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
